questions.question: When was the Central Rural Sanitation Programme launched?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__1986__**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The Central Rural Sanitation program, launched in 1986 was the first major structured initiative of cleanliness in India. This was launched by the Rajiv Gandhi led Congress government.
 
• The objective of CRSP was to construct individual sanitary latrines for the personal use of the BPL population.
 
• The main reason behind the program was to improve the quality of life of the rural people and provide privacy and dignity to women.
 
• CRSP was restructured to** Total Sanitation Campain (TSC)** from 1999 during the Atal Bihari Vajpayee government. The aim of this campaign was to eradicate open defecation by the year 2010.
 
• **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan** launched by the Modi-led NDA government on October 2, 2014, is a broader and largest program on sanitation by the Indian Government.

questions.question: What is the full form of MOU?
questions.solution:
**__Answer : (1)__ - Memorandum of Understanding** - is a formal agreement between two or more parties. Companies and organizations can use MoUs to establish official partnerships.

 
• MoUs are not legally binding but can be termed as the first steps towards a legal contract.
 
• MoUs are popular in multinational international relations because, unlike treaties, they take a short time to ratify and can be kept confidential.
 
• MoUs may also be used to modify existing treaties.
